title: What if every laugh made you stronger?
idea: There's a catch 10: every laugh makes Spud 10x stronger, until his friends stop laughing.

hook.what: two friends laugh at a potato who can't lift an empty bar; a STRENGTH board says x1

props.staged: wall board hung on the mirror rail by two straps
shown on the cut to the hero shot, in Spud's gloves

captions.text: What if every laugh made you stronger?

do.line: What if every laugh made you stronger?

do.style: laughing hard, bright, fast, mocking, can't stop laughing

do.line: Ha ha! Trust me, it's fake!
do.style: low, laughing, slow, teasing, sure of himself

do.line: Trust me... he can't lift us!
do.style: low, laughing, teasing, slow, sure of himself
laughing hard, high, giggling, out of breath
quiet, stunned, amazed, breathless, no laugh

do.line: No, no, no... laugh at me! LAUGH AT ME!
do.style: panicked, straining, desperate, shouting at the end

visible.why: he strains at the empty bar, they laugh, the board says x1
x10, the empty bar goes up like nothing
x100, three plates a side, the bar bends, up it goes
x1,000, he pumps the bent bar like it's nothing
Wedge dares him and the two sit on the bench
x10,000: the bench and both friends over his head (the cover)
silence: the board drains, the bench sinks
x1: it all comes down, cut on the impact
